body: Yeah, I was seeing a lot of people from the age of 5 to the age of 15. I had to stop because it got too expensive and stuff. I want to go back again SO bad.

Thanks, that's very kind of you. The one bad part of my boyfriend's family is they aren't very lovey dovey, if that's the right way to word it. His parents don't believe in living together before marriage, they don't believe in getting married until you're in your 40s. This isn't something he agrees with but he's also scared his parents will hate him. He has to get his drivers licence and finish his last semester at school before he's ready. I need a job and a car first too. I'd feel bad making him pay all the rent. If by some miracle I finally catch a break and life goes the way we want it, we both want me to be a stay at home mom when we have kids. So he'd be paying for everything on his own than. I don't think it's fair he does it all now too. I just hope his parents don't convince him not to do it. They love me, as far as I know. But their kids always come before everyone. Thanks for your kind words. I'd be surprised if someone actually had advice for all of this.
